simple.meaning: מְדָן (Mᵉdân) is a Hebrew word meaning “Medan , a son of Abraham.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: מְדָן (H4091) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Genesis 25:2, with occurrences in Genesis, 1 Chronicles.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מְדָן (H4091) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in מְדָן (H4091) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: מְדָן (Mᵉdân) / H4091 is traced through Genesis 25:2, 1 Chronicles 1:32 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
